pages.text: The Immortal Furnace has three work lanes. True Power processes one item per lane in 50 ticks; Immortal Power processes a full stack in 25. Terminal auto-fill restores the prior full input stack and returns outputs to storage.
Stage six unlocks a UUID-bound personal realm. Space expands from 3x3 to 7x7 and 19x19 chunks. Crossing a boundary warns and returns the player to the nearest allowed position.
Time rates unlock by stage: up to 4x at seven, 0.2x-8x at eight, 0.1x-16x at nine, and freeze through 32x at ten. Rates affect only that personal realm.
